svg.title: One Claude Code session coordinates two others through buddy: registered at SessionStart, it loads the skill with /buddy, opens two lanes with the harness, reads the roster and the claims while they work, waits on each lane with the harness (lane-a came back done, lane-b came back blocked), asks the ledger what closing each would leave, and closes their panes
svg.desc: Every output line is taken from the coordinator session's own transcript (the buddy hello hook's SessionStart output, each tool call's result as the harness recorded it, and the session's own words as the pane renders them), captured 2026-10-26 in a scratch clone with its own ledger; the typed prompt, the ⏺ tool-call lines and the lines starting with # are typeset. The scratch directory holding the briefs and the clone is written …; long lines are soft-wrapped at 112 columns or trimmed at a word with an ellipsis; a # … row marks lines cut from a result; each ⏩ line is the real time between the call above it and its result below, from the transcript's timestamps, and shorter gaps are not marked. Loops every 51 s; under prefers-reduced-motion the final frame is shown still.
svg.text: coordinator — a Claude Code session in the shared checkout

g.text: # SessionStart → buddy hello: the digest every session gets, as its context receives it
BUDDY: you are session coordinator (7a3bcae0-7f9d-4a6f-932c-4e8c9bff9848). Claim before taking a bundle: buddy
BUDDY: `buddy --help` lists every verb. Easy to miss: `buddy claim <slug> --dry-run` (forecast a refusal)
`--shared` (lanes co-hold a file); `buddy wait --on <slug>` (declare a wait on a peer) or `--until 2h` …
❯ /buddy Read …/briefs/coordinator.md in full and follow it as your brief.
(7a3bcae0-7f9d-4a6f-932c-4e8c9bff9848) pid 4662 pane herdr:w2A:p1X claude-opus-5-5/medium prompt 75k turn 11s
⏺ Bash(herdr tab create --workspace w2A --cwd "$PWD" --label lane-a --env BUDDY_LABEL=lane-a --env HOME=$HOME
⏺ Bash(herdr tab create --workspace w2A --cwd "$PWD" --label lane-b --env BUDDY_LABEL=lane-b --env HOME=$HOME
⏺ Bash(herdr agent start lane-a --kind claude --pane w2A:p1Y -- --model sonnet --permission-mode auto "You are
lane-a. Read …/briefs/lane-a.md in full and follow it exactly.")

# ⏩ fast-forward: 32s inside this call, herdr's startup wait; the lane was already running
